namaBarang: CDR FoodLab® - Food Chemical Analysis System
type: CDR FoodLab® Food Chemical Analysis System
summary: From the analysis of oils and fats to the quality control of dairy, bakery products, tomato derivatives, dried fruit and egg products. The most versatile instrument for the food industry.
description:
CDR FoodLab® is the innovative chemical analysis system for quality and process control that allows you to determine a wide range of chemical parameters on food, vegetable oils, animal fats, dairy products, egg products, bakery items, pet food, and animal feeds.

Thanks to analysis procedures developed by CDR laboratories specifically for food applications, CDR FoodLab® can be easily used by anyone right at the production line, at raw materials receiving, or in quality control laboratories—saving significant time and operational resources.

Key Advantages

  • Simple Analysis in Few Steps: Intuitive step-by-step on-screen tutorial guides the operator through each test procedure. No specialized laboratory technicians required.
  • Rapid Results: Testing times are dramatically reduced compared to conventional reference methods, providing accurate results within minutes.
  • Pre-filled & Disposable Reagents: Ready-to-use reagent vials eliminate toxic chemical handling, carcinogenic solvents (like chloroform or ether), and hazardous waste.
  • High Accuracy & Precision: Excellent correlation with official standard reference methods (AOCS, ISO, IUPAC, IDF).
  • Multitasking Mode: Allows simultaneous determination of multiple parameters on the same sample or testing up to 16 samples in parallel.
  • Free of Maintenance & Calibration Costs: Solid-state LED optical system supplied factory pre-calibrated with no periodic maintenance required.

Supported Applications & Parameters

  • Oils & Fats (Vegetable, Animal, Palm, Olive): Free Fatty Acids (Acidity), Peroxide Value (PV), p-Anisidine Value (AnV), Iodine Value (IV), Soaps.
  • Frying Oils & Fried Snacks: Free Fatty Acids, Peroxide Value, Anisidine Value, Soaps, Acrylamide precursor sugars on potatoes.
  • Fish Oil & Marine Lipids: Free Fatty Acids, Peroxide Value, Anisidine Value.
  • Nuts & Dried Fruits: Acidity / Free Fatty Acids, Peroxide Value of the extracted oil.
  • Milk & Dairy Products: Lactose, Milk Urea Nitrogen (MUN), Chloride, Ammonia, Peroxidase, L-Lactic Acid, Alkaline Phosphatase (ALP), Furosine, Calcium, Hydrogen Peroxide.
  • Egg & Ovoproducts: L-Lactic Acid, D-3-Hydroxybutyric Acid, Cholesterol, Colour, Free Fatty Acids.
  • Bakery Products & Spreads: Free Fatty Acids, Peroxide Value, Anisidine Value, Lactose, Alcohol by Volume.
  • Tomato Derivatives: Lactic Acid (D+L), Reducing Sugars, Chloride.
  • Animal Feed & Pet Food: Free Fatty Acids, Peroxide Value, Anisidine Value, Iodine Value, Xanthophylls.

namaBarang: CDR FoodLab® Jr - Compact Chemical Analysis System
type: CDR FoodLab® Jr Compact Chemical Analysis System
summary: The compact, portable chemical analysis system designed for performing essential quality and process controls on oils, fats, and food products in smaller laboratories, field testing, or directly at production lines.
description:
CDR FoodLab® Jr is the compact, portable chemical analysis system designed for performing essential quality and process controls on oils, fats, and food products in smaller laboratories, field testing, or directly at production lines.

Despite its small footprint and ultra-lightweight design (only 0.80 kg), CDR FoodLab® Jr maintains the exact same photometric accuracy, reliability, and correlation with reference methods as the standard model, with pre-filled reagents and zero periodic calibration.

Key Advantages

  • Compact & Portable: Weighing only 0.80 kg with optional lithium-ion battery for field testing anywhere.
  • Same High Accuracy: Equipped with state-of-the-art LED optical technology correlated with official standard methods.
  • Customisable Configuration: Tailored with the specific analysis panel your laboratory or facility requires.
  • Pre-filled Reagents: Reagents provided in disposable test tubes eliminate dangerous chemical preparation.
  • Fast Results: Easy 3-step operation yields quantitative results in minutes.
  • Zero Maintenance: No lamp replacements and no regular maintenance needed.

namaBarang: CDR PalmOilTester - Palm Oil Chemical Analysis System
type: CDR PalmOilTester Palm Oil Chemical Analysis System
summary: The simple and reliable system for the analysis of crude palm oil (CPO) and refined palm oil. Used by producers, quality laboratories, and directly on mills & production lines.
description:
CDR PalmOilTester is the globally acclaimed analysis system specifically engineered for the palm oil industry. In Indonesia, where palm oil production is critical, CDR PalmOilTester enables rapid testing of Crude Palm Oil (CPO) and refined fractions directly in mills, receiving points, refineries, and QC laboratories.

It tests Free Fatty Acids (FFA), Peroxide Value (PV), DOBI & Carotene, and p-Anisidine Value in minutes without using hazardous solvents such as hexane, chloroform, or toxic titrants.

Calibration Pre-calibrated at factory according to standard AOCS / ISO methods
